messages.subject: Causal Mediation Analysis – online seminar
parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Causal Mediation Analysis led by Martin Danka (Centre for Longitudinal Studies, University College London) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar on Causal Mediation Analysis provides a robust framework for understanding the intricate pathways through which effects operate, addressing limitations of traditional methods. Researchers will acquire practical skills in implementing these advanced techniques using R, enabling more rigorous and nuanced assessment of complex causal relationships. These methodologies can be directly integrated into your existing R-based analytical workflows, empowering you to uncover deeper insights and strengthen the validity of your empirical findings.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
